newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Ruling Awami League candidate Suranjit Sengupta won the parliamentary by-election in Habiganj-2 constituency, held on Tuesday. The seat was vaccated due to the death of a ruling party member.
Power generation in the country is being seriously disrupted due to shortfall in gas supply caused by poor gas transmission network, said the state-run Bangladesh Oil Gas & Mineral resources Co.

A seminar on investment opportunities in Bangladesh will be held in New York from October 23 to 25 when Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be visiting the United States to attend the UN General Assembly session.
The state-run gas company has proposed a 20 percent terporary cut in gas supply to two major fertiliser companies and divert gas to power plants in overcoming loadshedding.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asked border guards to take strong measures against smuggling to protect the country's economy from unfair competition.

Bangladesh, on behlf of LDCs, has urged the donor countries and multilateral funding agencies to consider cancellation of debts of LDCs irrespective of their level of indebtedness. The appeal was made by Bangladesh representative at the on-going UNCTAD session in Geneva.
